operator: Halton Borough Council (Mersey Gateway Crossings Board; tolls collected by merseyflow)
about: England: the toll charges of the Mersey Gateway and Silver Jubilee bridges (Runcorn–Widnes) from 1 April 2025, set by Halton Borough Council's Road User Charging Scheme Order, as merseyflow's summary of the change gives them, a table published only as an image in that PDF. Transcribed by hand; tools/tables fetches the PDF again and says if it has changed (sha256). Per crossing, either bridge, either way, free-flow. Class 3: vehicles of 3.5-12 tonnes (and buses under 5 t); class 4: over 12 tonnes (and buses over 5 t).
